# OTLP push (`source_type: otlp`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

The agent receives OpenTelemetry metrics over OTLP/HTTP (JSON) and reports the latest matching data point, aggregated by `aggregation`.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: not supported

## Value and unit

- no unit: aggregated value of the pushed OTLP data points, in the instrument's own unit

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `metric_name` | yes | string |  | up to 256 characters |
| `attribute_filters` | no | object |  |  |
| `aggregation` | no | enum | `"latest"` | `latest`, `count`, `sum`, `mean`, `p50`, `p95`, `p99` |
| `staleness_ms` | no | integer | `120000` | 1000 to 86400000 |

## Rules

- Senders push to the agent's receiver (default `127.0.0.1:4318`). Binding it beyond loopback needs `OBSERVER_OTLP_BEARER_TOKEN` on the agent.
- A metric with no data point newer than `staleness_ms` reports `no_data`.
- Cannot be run with testProbe: nothing is pushed during a test.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: otlp
source_config: {"metric_name":"http.server.duration","attribute_filters":{"service.name":"checkout"},"aggregation":"p95"}
```
